entries.en: Go to the Border Village in Bichon Province and report to Assistant Jane (284,606) to collect your patrol equipment.
entries.zh-TW: 前往比奇省邊境村，向助理簡（284,606）報告，領取巡邏裝備。
entries.pt-BR: Vá à Vila da Fronteira, na Província de Bichon, e fale com a Assistente Jane (284,606) para receber seu equipamento de patrulha.
aliases: 前往比奇省边境村，向助理简（284,606）报告，领取巡逻装备。
Visit Assistant Jane in Bichon Province (map 0, 284,606) and complete the first ordinary NPC report.

entries.en: Open your equipment panel and equip a weapon suitable for your class and level.
entries.zh-TW: 打開裝備界面，裝備一把符合自身職業和等級要求的武器。
entries.pt-BR: Abra o painel de equipamentos e equipe uma arma adequada à sua classe e ao seu nível.
aliases: 打开装备界面，装备一把符合自身职业和等级要求的武器。
Open your equipment and equip a weapon your class and level can use.

entries.en: Defeat 2 Scarecrows near the village, then defeat 2 Raking Cats northeast of the village near (340,550). Amber squares on the big map mark hunting areas, not live monster positions. Bring small HP potions before leaving.
entries.zh-TW: 消滅村莊附近的 2 個稻草人，再前往村莊東北方（340,550）附近消滅 2 只釘耙貓。大地圖的琥珀色方框表示狩獵區域，不是怪物的實時位置；出發前準備小型紅藥。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 2 Espantalhos perto da vila e 2 Gatos com Ancinho a nordeste, perto de (340,550). Os quadrados âmbar no mapa grande indicam áreas de caça, não a posição atual dos monstros. Leve poções pequenas de HP.
aliases: 消灭村庄附近的 2 个稻草人，再前往村庄东北方（340,550）附近消灭 2 只钉耙猫。大地图的琥珀色方框表示狩猎区域，不是怪物的实时位置；出发前准备小型红药。

Defeat 2 Scarecrows near the village. For 2 RakingCats, head northeast of the starter village toward (340,550). Open the big map: amber boxes mark hunting areas for unfinished targets, not exact live monster positions. Carry small HP medicine.

entries.en: Defeat 2 Omas near the village and complete your class practice: Warriors use Fencing, Wizards use Fireball, and Taoists use Healing. See the class practice instructions for exact requirements.
entries.zh-TW: 消滅村莊附近的 2 個半獸人，並完成職業練習：戰士使用基本劍術，法師使用火球術，道士使用治癒術。具體要求見職業練習說明。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 2 Omas perto da vila e conclua o treino da sua classe: Guerreiro usa Esgrima, Mago usa Bola de Fogo e Taoísta usa Cura. Veja as instruções do treino para os requisitos exatos.
aliases: 消灭村庄附近的 2 个半兽人，并完成职业练习：战士使用基本剑术，法师使用火球术，道士使用治愈术。具体要求见职业练习说明。
Defeat 2 Omas near the village, then use your class's first skill: Fencing, FireBall, or Healing.

entries.en: Travel north from the Border Village to the Bichon city safe area (328,264). Open the big map for the destination. Progress updates inside the city safe area; the Border Village safe area does not count. Bring HP potions.
entries.zh-TW: 從邊境村向北前往比奇城安全區（328,264）。打開大地圖查看目的地；進入比奇城安全區后更新進度，邊境村安全區不計入此任務。路上準備紅藥。
entries.pt-BR: Siga ao norte da Vila da Fronteira até a zona segura da cidade de Bichon (328,264). Veja o destino no mapa grande. O progresso é atualizado dentro da zona segura da cidade; a zona da vila não conta. Leve poções de HP.
aliases: 从边境村向北前往比奇城安全区（328,264）。打开大地图查看目的地；进入比奇城安全区后更新进度，边境村安全区不计入此任务。路上准备红药。

Head north from the starter village to Bichon city safe area at (328,264), map 0. Open the big map for the marked destination. The starter village safe area does not count. Progress updates on entering the city safe area; carry HP medicine for the journey.

entries.en: Before leaving town, buy a small HP or MP potion from an ordinary shop.
entries.zh-TW: 離開城鎮前，從普通商店購買一瓶小型紅藥或小型藍藥。
entries.pt-BR: Antes de sair da cidade, compre uma poção pequena de HP ou MP em uma loja comum.
aliases: 离开城镇前，从普通商店购买一瓶小型红药或小型蓝药。
Buy one basic HP or MP potion from a legitimate town merchant before leaving for the forest.

entries.en: Defeat 4 Forest Yetis in Bichon Forest. Restock HP potions and bring MP potions or Amulets as needed for your class.
entries.zh-TW: 在比奇森林消滅 4 只森林雪人。先補充紅藥，並根據職業準備藍藥或護身符。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 4 Yetis da Floresta na Floresta de Bichon. Reponha poções de HP e leve poções de MP ou Amuletos conforme sua classe.
aliases: 在比奇森林消灭 4 只森林雪人。先补充红药，并根据职业准备蓝药或护身符。
In the Bichon forest, defeat 4 Forest Yetis. Restock HP and class MP or Amulets first.

entries.en: Defeat 2 Omas and complete your class practice, then report to the Bichon Wall Board (334,259).
entries.zh-TW: 消滅 2 個半獸人並完成職業練習，然后向比奇城牆公告板（334,259）報告。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 2 Omas e conclua o treino da sua classe. Depois, volte ao Quadro da Muralha de Bichon (334,259).
aliases: 消灭 2 个半兽人并完成职业练习，然后向比奇城墙公告板（334,259）报告。
Defeat 2 Omas, practise your class skill, then report to the Board in Bichon Province (map 0, 334,259).

entries.en: Follow the map entrance route into Oma Cave 1F. Bring HP and MP potions; Taoists should carry Amulets for the skills they use.
entries.zh-TW: 沿地圖入口路線進入半獸人洞穴一層。出發前準備紅藥、藍藥；道士按技能需要攜帶護身符。
entries.pt-BR: Siga as entradas dos mapas até o 1º andar da Caverna dos Omas. Leve poções de HP e MP; Taoístas devem levar Amuletos para suas habilidades.
aliases: 沿地图入口路线进入半兽人洞穴一层。出发前准备红药、蓝药；道士按技能需要携带护身符。
Use the legal entrance to the Cave Rescue area (D001); bring HP, MP, or Taoist Amulets.

entries.en: Defeat 4 Skeletons in Oma Cave 1F. Keep enough potions for the rest of the rescue route.
entries.zh-TW: 在半獸人洞穴一層消滅 4 只骷髏，為后續救援路線保留足夠的藥水。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 4 Esqueletos no 1º andar da Caverna dos Omas. Reserve poções suficientes para o restante do resgate.
aliases: 在半兽人洞穴一层消灭 4 只骷髅，为后续救援路线保留足够的药水。
In D001, defeat 4 Skeletons and keep enough healing supplies for the rescue route.

entries.en: Defeat 3 Skeletons in Oma Cave 1F and complete your class practice with Slaying, Great Fireball, or Soul Fireball.
entries.zh-TW: 在半獸人洞穴一層消滅 3 只骷髏，並完成本職業的攻殺劍術、大火球或靈魂火符練習。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 3 Esqueletos no 1º andar da Caverna dos Omas e conclua o treino com Golpe Mortal, Grande Bola de Fogo ou Talismã de Fogo, conforme sua classe.
aliases: 在半兽人洞穴一层消灭 3 只骷髅，并完成本职业的攻杀剑术、大火球或灵魂火符练习。
Defeat 3 Skeletons in D001 and practise Slaying, GreatFireBall, or SoulFireBall for your class.

entries.en: Defeat 1 Skeleton in Oma Cave 1F and complete your class practice, then report to the Bichon Wall Board (334,259).
entries.zh-TW: 在半獸人洞穴一層消滅 1 只骷髏並完成職業練習，然后返回比奇城牆公告板（334,259）報告。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 1 Esqueleto no 1º andar da Caverna dos Omas e conclua seu treino de classe. Depois, volte ao Quadro da Muralha de Bichon (334,259).
aliases: 在半兽人洞穴一层消灭 1 只骷髅并完成职业练习，然后返回比奇城墙公告板（334,259）报告。
Defeat 1 Skeleton in D001, finish the class practice, then return to the Board at map 0 (334,259).

entries.en: Follow the map entrance route into Dead Mine 1F. Bring HP and MP potions; Taoists should carry Amulets for the skills they use.
entries.zh-TW: 沿地圖入口路線進入死亡礦區一層。進礦前準備紅藥、藍藥；道士按技能需要攜帶護身符。
entries.pt-BR: Siga as entradas dos mapas até o 1º andar da Mina Morta. Leve poções de HP e MP; Taoístas devem levar Amuletos para suas habilidades.
aliases: 沿地图入口路线进入死亡矿区一层。进矿前准备红药、蓝药；道士按技能需要携带护身符。
Enter the Dead Mine through its legal route to D401; pack HP and MP or Amulets before the mine.

entries.en: Defeat 3 Zombies (Type 2) and 2 Zombies (Type 3) in Dead Mine 1F. Restock consumables before going deeper.
entries.zh-TW: 在死亡礦區一層消滅 3 只殭屍（二型）和 2 只殭屍（三型），補足消耗品后再繼續深入。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 3 Zumbis (Tipo 2) e 2 Zumbis (Tipo 3) no 1º andar da Mina Morta. Reponha os consumíveis antes de avançar.
aliases: 在死亡矿区一层消灭 3 只僵尸（二型）和 2 只僵尸（三型），补足消耗品后再继续深入。
At the D401 mine mouth, defeat 3 Zombie2 and 2 Zombie3; refresh supplies before continuing.

entries.en: Defeat 1 Zombie (Type 2) in Dead Mine 1F and complete your class practice: Warriors use Thrusting, Wizards deal spell damage then move, and Taoists carry poison powder and use Poisoning.
entries.zh-TW: 在死亡礦區一層消滅 1 只殭屍（二型），並完成職業練習：戰士使用刺殺劍術，法師造成法術傷害后移動，道士準備毒粉后施毒。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 1 Zumbi (Tipo 2) no 1º andar da Mina Morta e conclua o treino: Guerreiro usa Estocada, Mago causa dano mágico e depois se move, e Taoísta leva pó de veneno e usa Envenenamento.
aliases: 在死亡矿区一层消灭 1 只僵尸（二型），并完成职业练习：战士使用刺杀剑术，法师造成法术伤害后移动，道士准备毒粉后施毒。
Defeat 1 Zombie2 in D401 and practise Thrusting, repositioned spell damage, or Poisoning with legal materials.

entries.en: Defeat 3 Zombies (Type 2) in Dead Mine 1F and complete your class practice, then report to the Bichon Wall Board (334,259).
entries.zh-TW: 在死亡礦區一層消滅 3 只殭屍（二型）並完成職業練習，然后向比奇城牆公告板（334,259）報告。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 3 Zumbis (Tipo 2) no 1º andar da Mina Morta e conclua o treino da sua classe. Depois, volte ao Quadro da Muralha de Bichon (334,259).
aliases: 在死亡矿区一层消灭 3 只僵尸（二型）并完成职业练习，然后向比奇城墙公告板（334,259）报告。
Defeat 3 Zombie3 in D401, complete your class combat practice, then report to the Board (map 0, 334,259).

entries.en: Equip armour suitable for your class and level, then report your expedition preparations to the Bichon Wall Board (334,259).
entries.zh-TW: 裝備符合自身職業和等級要求的盔甲，並向比奇城牆公告板（334,259）報告遠征準備情況。
entries.pt-BR: Equipe uma armadura adequada à sua classe e ao seu nível. Depois, informe seus preparativos ao Quadro da Muralha de Bichon (334,259).
aliases: 装备符合自身职业和等级要求的盔甲，并向比奇城墙公告板（334,259）报告远征准备情况。
At the Board in Bichon Province (map 0, 334,259), equip eligible class armour and complete the expedition preparation report.

entries.en: Follow the map entrance route to the Wooma Temple entrance and complete your class practice. Warriors need Half Moon, Wizards need Lightning, and Taoists need Summon Skeleton and its materials.
entries.zh-TW: 沿地圖入口路線抵達沃瑪寺廟入口，並完成職業練習。戰士準備半月彎刀，法師準備疾光電影，道士準備召喚骷髏及所需材料。
entries.pt-BR: Siga as entradas dos mapas até a entrada do Templo de Wooma e conclua o treino. Guerreiro precisa de Meia-Lua, Mago de Relâmpago e Taoísta de Invocar Esqueleto e seus materiais.
aliases: 沿地图入口路线抵达沃玛寺庙入口，并完成职业练习。战士准备半月弯刀，法师准备雷电术，道士准备召唤骷髅及所需材料。
Reach the Wooma entrance by its legal route in D021 and prepare HalfMoon, Lightning, or Taoist spell materials.

entries.en: Defeat 3 Dung Worms in Wooma Temple 1F. Restock consumables before going deeper.
entries.zh-TW: 在沃瑪寺廟一層消滅 3 只糞蟲，補足消耗品后再深入。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 3 Vermes de Esterco no 1º andar do Templo de Wooma. Reponha os consumíveis antes de avançar.
aliases: 在沃玛寺庙一层消灭 3 只粪虫，补足消耗品后再深入。
In the D022 outpost, defeat 3 Dungs; restock before moving deeper into Wooma territory.

entries.en: Defeat 3 Wooma Soldiers in Wooma Temple 1F. Bring HP potions and your class combat consumables.
entries.zh-TW: 在沃瑪寺廟一層消滅 3 名沃瑪戰士。準備好紅藥和本職業的戰斗消耗品。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 3 Soldados de Wooma no 1º andar do Templo de Wooma. Leve poções de HP e os consumíveis de combate da sua classe.
aliases: 在沃玛寺庙一层消灭 3 名沃玛战士。准备好红药和本职业的战斗消耗品。
In D022, defeat 3 Wooma Soldiers. Keep healing and class combat supplies ready.

entries.en: Defeat 3 Wooma Fighters in Wooma Temple 1F and complete the final combat practice described for your class.
entries.zh-TW: 在沃瑪寺廟一層消滅 3 名沃瑪勇士，並按職業練習說明完成最后的戰斗練習。
entries.pt-BR: Derrote 3 Combatentes de Wooma no 1º andar do Templo de Wooma e conclua o treino de combate final indicado para sua classe.
aliases: 在沃玛寺庙一层消灭 3 名沃玛勇士，并按职业练习说明完成最后的战斗练习。
Defeat 3 Wooma Fighters in D022 and complete the final class combat practice with your learned skills.

entries.en: Return to Bichon Province by the normal route and deliver your expedition report to the Bichon Wall Board (334,259).
entries.zh-TW: 沿正常路線返回比奇省，向比奇城牆公告板（334,259）提交遠征報告。
entries.pt-BR: Volte à Província de Bichon pelo caminho normal e entregue o relatório da expedição no Quadro da Muralha de Bichon (334,259).
aliases: 沿正常路线返回比奇省，向比奇城墙公告板（334,259）提交远征报告。
Return by the normal route and deliver the expedition report to the Board in Bichon Province (map 0, 334,259).

entries.en: Reach level 15 and complete Clear the forest path, then claim your growth reward in the Quest Diary and learn the class skill included.
entries.zh-TW: 達到 15 級並完成清理森林道路任務后，在任務日志領取成長獎勵，學習獎勵中的職業技能。
entries.pt-BR: Chegue ao nível 15 e conclua Limpe o caminho da floresta. Resgate a recompensa no Diário de Missões e aprenda a habilidade de classe recebida.
aliases: 达到 15 级并完成清理森林道路任务后，在任务日志领取成长奖励，学习奖励中的职业技能。
After the forest report, open the Quest Diary for the level-15 growth reward and learn its class skill.

entries.en: Reach level 20 and deliver the cave patrol report, then collect your growth weapon from the Bichon Wall Board (334,259).
entries.zh-TW: 達到 20 級並完成洞穴巡邏報告后，向比奇城牆公告板（334,259）領取成長武器。
entries.pt-BR: Chegue ao nível 20 e entregue o relatório da patrulha da caverna. Receba sua arma de progresso no Quadro da Muralha de Bichon (334,259).
aliases: 达到 20 级并完成洞穴巡逻报告后，向比奇城墙公告板（334,259）领取成长武器。
After the rescue report, claim the level-20 growth weapon from the Board in Bichon Province (map 0, 334,259).

entries.en: Reach level 25 and deliver the mine patrol report, then collect your growth armour and weapon from the Bichon Wall Board (334,259).
entries.zh-TW: 達到 25 級並完成礦區巡邏報告后，向比奇城牆公告板（334,259）領取成長盔甲和武器。
entries.pt-BR: Chegue ao nível 25 e entregue o relatório da patrulha da mina. Receba sua armadura e arma de progresso no Quadro da Muralha de Bichon (334,259).
aliases: 达到 25 级并完成矿区巡逻报告后，向比奇城墙公告板（334,259）领取成长盔甲和武器。
After the mine report, claim the level-25 armour and weapon growth reward from the Board at map 0 (334,259).

entries.en: Reach level 30 and deliver the expedition report, then collect your growth reward from the Bichon Wall Board (334,259).
entries.zh-TW: 達到 30 級並提交遠征報告后，向比奇城牆公告板（334,259）領取成長獎勵。
entries.pt-BR: Chegue ao nível 30 e entregue o relatório da expedição. Receba sua recompensa de progresso no Quadro da Muralha de Bichon (334,259).
aliases: 达到 30 级并提交远征报告后，向比奇城墙公告板（334,259）领取成长奖励。
After the final report, claim the level-30 growth reward from the Board in Bichon Province (map 0, 334,259).

entries.zh-TW: 先學會基本劍術，這是被動技能。
entries.pt-BR: Aprenda Esgrima primeiro. É uma habilidade passiva.
aliases: 先学会基本剑术，这是被动技能。

entries.zh-TW: 學會基本劍術后，普通攻擊命中怪物。
entries.pt-BR: Após aprender Esgrima, acerte um monstro com um ataque normal.
aliases: 学会基本剑术后，普通攻击命中怪物。

entries.zh-TW: 先學會攻殺劍術，這是被動技能。
entries.pt-BR: Aprenda Golpe Mortal primeiro. É uma habilidade passiva.
aliases: 先学会攻杀剑术，这是被动技能。

entries.pt-BR: Acerte um ataque normal após aprender Golpe Mortal

entries.zh-TW: 學會攻殺劍術后，普通攻擊命中怪物。

entries.en: Damage a monster with Fireball. Casting without a hit does not count.
entries.zh-TW: 用火球術對怪物造成傷害，空放不計。
entries.pt-BR: Cause dano a um monstro com Bola de Fogo. Conjurar sem acertar não conta.
aliases: 用火球术对怪物造成伤害，空放不计。

entries.en: Successfully cast Healing with yourself as the target.
entries.zh-TW: 以自己為目標成功施放治癒術。
entries.pt-BR: Use Cura com sucesso, tendo você mesmo como alvo.
aliases: 以自己为目标成功施放治愈术。

Cause dano com Grande Bola de Fogo

entries.zh-TW: 用大火球對怪物造成傷害。
entries.pt-BR: Cause dano a um monstro com Grande Bola de Fogo.
aliases: 用大火球对怪物造成伤害。

entries.en: Learn Spirit Sword first. It is a passive skill.
entries.zh-TW: 先學會精神力戰法，這是被動技能。
entries.pt-BR: Aprenda Técnica Espiritual da Espada primeiro. É uma habilidade passiva.
aliases: 先学会精神力战法，这是被动技能。

entries.en: Land a normal attack with Spirit Sword learned
entries.zh-TW: 普攻命中（已學精神力戰法）
entries.pt-BR: Acerte um ataque normal após aprender Técnica Espiritual da Espada
aliases: 普攻命中（已学精神力战法）

entries.en: After learning Spirit Sword, hit a monster with a normal attack.
entries.zh-TW: 學會精神力戰法后，普通攻擊命中怪物。
entries.pt-BR: Após aprender Técnica Espiritual da Espada, acerte um monstro com um ataque normal.
aliases: 学会精神力战法后，普通攻击命中怪物。

entries.en: Learn Soul Fireball first and equip Amulets.
entries.zh-TW: 先學會靈魂火符，裝備護身符。
entries.pt-BR: Aprenda Talismã de Fogo e equipe Amuletos.
aliases: 先学会灵魂火符，装备护身符。

entries.pt-BR: Cause dano com Talismã de Fogo
